name: Huro
description: Huro was a planet in the Huro system within the Ciutric sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Trever Flume stopped at an exclusive florist on Coruscant who sold exotic blooms and bought a small plant with vibrant yellow leaves native to the planet Huro. It was the cheapest option they had.
